query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',id,'session_id',session_id,'operation_id',operation_id,'step_index',step_index,'batch_id',batch_id,'batch_index',batch_index,'batch_verdict',batch_verdict,'state',CASE WHEN state IN ('proposed','approved','batch_pending') AND expires_at<=now() THEN 'expired' WHEN batch_verdict IS NOT NULL THEN batch_verdict WHEN batch_id IS NOT NULL AND state='completed' THEN 'unknown' WHEN state='batch_pending' THEN 'proposed' ELSE state END,'expires_at',expires_at,'request_hash',encode(request_hash,'hex'),'proposal',CASE WHEN state IN ('proposed','approved','batch_pending') AND expires_at>now() THEN proposal ELSE NULL END,'http_status',http_status,'finished_at',finished_at,'review_facts',CASE WHEN state IN ('proposed','approved','batch_pending') AND expires_at>now() THEN review_facts ELSE NULL END,'evidence',evidence) AS "data!" FROM assistant_actions WHERE workspace_id=$1 AND user_id=$2 AND login_id=$3 AND batch_id=$4 ORDER BY batch_index LIMIT 10
